name.description:
Disk name.
If disk name already exists in the Tenant, it will be used

encrypted.description: Enable disk encryption. Ignored when the disk already exists; only honored when a new disk is created via this request.

asyncReplication.description: Use async replication (sync replication is the default). Ignored when the disk already exists; only honored when a new disk is created via this request.

local.description: True if the disk uses non-replicated local storage. Read-only; legacy disks may still report true.

enabled.description: Enable firewall functions to filter access ports

allowedInboundPorts.description: Specify list of ports to expose

subnets.description:
Subnet names within this VPC to connect to.
Each subnet adds secondary network interfaces to the VM.

userData.description: Cloud-Init UserData script. Always empty for Windows VMs.

defaultUser.description: Default username for the VM. Empty for custom (imported) images.

credentials.description: Windows credentials. Only present for official Windows images on Create.

password.description: Generated password for the Windows administrator account. Only returned on Create.

reason.description: Human-readable reason explaining the current status when the VM is not Ready (e.g. ResourceQuotaExceeded, ImagePullError).

404.description: Not Found - Resource does not exist

503.description: Service Unavailable - Platform is temporarily unavailable
